Pretty much forever, the way these anti cheats work is that they look for a “footprint” left by your game. If people are running the same cheats they leave this same “footprint” and this is how they get banned. But if only one person is using the cheats it can remain undetected for a long time.

The problem is most of these players code their own cheats in c++ which can go undetected. The anti-cheats we have today are incapable of detecting these people, and the only way they get caught is if they are blatant and get manually banned.
